items.text: the flow. Slide two fingers up or down together on the stage and every speed goes faster or slower at once, from ×¼ to ×3 (it stops at ×1 on the way; a small "flow ×1.4" shows while you slide). A quick two-finger double tap puts it back to ×1. It stays on this device and never changes a scene: the robot, the dice and your scenes play on under it. On a computer: shift-scroll, or = and -, and \ to reset
on a computer, alt-scroll (option) sets the strength; shift-scroll is the flow now
the robot's signal is clean rings now, rising from its antenna on the beat (they read as dust before)

your library. Every picture and video you bring in is kept on this device and shows in Source's shelf (drag down on Source) as small screens, the one in use lit. Tap one to bring it back; hold one to remove it
in the panels, CLOSE is just its ⌄ now (the shelf keeps its word)

Source's drawer shows only Picture · Video · Camera until there is a source; then its tools slide open beside them. Show: tap steps, hold for show, zoom and turn. Drive: tap on or off, hold for how much

a water surface over the stage. In Sound's shelf, under Water, pick a surface (Still pond, Drip, Rain, Wake, Glass): the picture is seen through moving water. Every water voice drops a ripple where it sounds, a tap always ripples, your finger stirs it, and the rain bed rains on it. Stills and videos show it too
the shelf follows the panel you open: open Source and the shelf shows Source's controls
the capture panel works like the others: its tabs, ‹ › and CLOSE along the bottom, sliding down to its button. Still · Video · GIF live in the shelf only
each shape in the capture panel shows its proportion, a small frame drawn at the true ratio
closing the shelf no longer closes an open panel, and a press in the shelf leaves the panel open
one set of sizes for tiles, beads and segments across the shelf and panels
the shelf keeps clear of the corner buttons (report a bug, full screen); they stay in their corners
the arrows that stepped between panels left the panels' sides: they sit in the bottom band now, ‹ | › | CLOSE, and the panels' CLOSE faces down like the shelf's (one and the same button)
the drawers, the shelf and the panels share one corner
Auto play fits again with the bar higher (it scrolled a little since 0.28.5)
a Water strip in the mixer, beside beat, bytebeat, music, mic and loop: the bed and the water voices together, with level, mute, solo and its wave. It replaces the Water row's bed level
"field hears" in the Water row: the water voices reach the field too, so a drop pulses it (off by default, as before)
the robot and the dice run together: the robot changes the scene on its clock, the dice rolls the style in between, never right on top of a change
the die tumbles through its faces on every roll and lands on one; while it rolls by itself its pips pulse in its rhythm
a lit dice shows its amount ring again, dark on the blue
the shelf's top edge rises into a small peak under its button and slides to the next one; no more blue caret. CLOSE reads top to bottom, down by its ⌄
10 px more room between the marks under the bar and the shelf (the bar sits a little higher, and still never moves)
